exit 0
--- stdout
Remove a task from the state database.
Useful for removing tasks that were created but are no longer needed. Tasks
in MERGED state cannot be deleted by default (as they represent integrated work).
Usage:
liza delete task <task-id> [flags]
Flags:
--delete-worktree also delete the associated git worktree and branch
--force force deletion even if task has dependencies or is in restricted state
-h, --help help for task
--reason string reason for deleting the task (default "manual deletion")
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
